visual.name: atlynScatter
visual.description: Turn any two measures into an explainable quadrant scatter chart: choose median, mean, zero, fixed, or benchmark thresholds, show a least-squares trend line with its equation and R-squared, size and colour bubbles by additional measures, and keep every point reachable by keyboard and screen reader.

en-US.noData: Add one Category, one numeric X measure, and one numeric Y measure.
en-US.invalid: X and Y must contain finite numeric values. Invalid rows were excluded.
en-US.compact: Increase the visual size to show the scatter plot.
en-US.reduced: Power BI reduced the data window; showing a bounded sample.
en-US.partial: The host supplied a bounded segment; additional rows were not requested.

es-ES.noData: Agregue una categoría, una medida X numérica y una medida Y numérica.
es-ES.invalid: X e Y deben contener valores numéricos finitos. Se excluyeron las filas no válidas.
es-ES.compact: Aumente el tamaño del objeto visual para mostrar el gráfico.
es-ES.reduced: Power BI redujo la ventana de datos; se muestra una muestra limitada.
es-ES.partial: El host proporcionó un segmento limitado; no se solicitaron filas adicionales.
